description: Edit an existing task's title, description, priority, deadline, category, or helpful links. Use when the user wants to modify task details.

deadline.description: New deadline as ISO date string (e.g. 2026-03-15), or null to clear (omit to keep current)

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

helpful_links.description: Replace the task's full set of helpful links with this array. Each entry MUST use markdown link format "[Page or resource title](url)" so the UI can render a readable label (e.g. "[California Courts — Probate Self-Help](https://www.courts.ca.gov/selfhelp-probate.htm)"). Pass [] to clear all links. Omit to keep current. Only include URLs you've verified (e.g. via web_search) or that were already in context — do not invent URLs.

name: edit_task
